name: uv
description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
summary: Astral supports using AI as a coding tool, but a human must be in the loop, understand the AI-produced work and remain responsible for the code submitted. AI-written comments, issue reports, pull request descriptions and answers to maintainers are not accepted, apart from AI proofreading or translation for non-native English speakers, and autonomous agents may not contribute.

evidence.quote: We support using AI (i.e., LLMs) as tools for coding.

However, you remain
responsible for any code you publish and we are responsible for any code we
merge and release.

Due to the foundational nature of our projects, we require a human in the loop
who understands the work produced by AI.

If you are opening a pull request, we expect you to be able to explain the
proposed changes in your own words. This includes the pull request body and
responses to questions.

If you are opening an issue, we expect you to describe the problem in your own
words.

If you are opening a pull request, we expect you to be able to explain the
proposed changes in your own words. This includes the pull request body and
responses to questions.

**Do not copy responses from the AI when replying to
questions from maintainers.**

**AI should not be used to generate comments when communicating with
maintainers**.

We expect comments on our projects to be written by humans. We
may hide any comments that we believe are AI generated.

We understand that AI is useful when communicating as a non-native English
speaker. If you are using AI to edit your comments for this purpose, you must:
- Take the time to ensure it reflects your own voice and ideas.
- Write in your native language, and include the AI translation in a quote block beneath it.

If you wish to include context from an interaction with AI in your comments, it
must be in a quote block (e.g., using `>`) and disclosed as such.

It must be
accompanied by human commentary explaining the relevance and implications of the
context. Do not share long snippets.

**We do not allow autonomous agents to
be used for contributing to our projects**. We will close any pull requests that
we believe were created autonomously.
